# Rise and Battle the Day

## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13

## Reflection
Paul's charge to the Corinthian church was not a suggestion—it was a battle cry. Notice the progression: watchfulness comes first. A soldier who sleeps through the alarm never makes it to the fight. Before you can stand firm, you must be awake to what's happening around you and within you. The enemy doesn't announce his arrival; he slips in through distraction, compromise, and slow surrender.

Then comes the command to act like men. In a culture that rewards passivity and calls it peace, God calls His sons to courage. Strength here isn't bravado—it's the settled resolve to do what's right when it's hard, to lead when it's costly, and to stand when everyone else sits down. But notice the anchor: "in the faith." Your strength has a source. You're not summoning willpower from an empty tank; you're drawing from the God who never tires.

Today, you'll face a dozen small moments where you can either drift or stand. Choose to stand. The battle is real, but so is your God.

## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups, and with each rep, thank God for the strength He supplies—not your own. Then stand firm in one area today where you've been tempted to drift.
